meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会先喊出「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」,然后作为 Lead 带 5 名互相攻击的成员团队审查计划,只留经得起攻击的结论,再交给专职规划者写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严格度,或你要求 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批评式规划时触发;需在顶层 lead 会话中运行,且团队工具可用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我审查这份上线计划
say.note: 先对抗评审,再交给规划者出正式计划

say.text: 我要交叉批评式规划:让 5 名成员互相攻击我的方案
say.note: 成员互批,Lead 汇总幸存结论

howto.what_en: Claude first says "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", then acts as Lead of a 5-member adversarial team that attacks each other's findings, keeps only the defensible insights, and hands them to a dedicated planner who writes the formal plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when planning needs maximum rigor, or you ask for a hyperplan / adversarial / cross-critique plan. Needs a top-level lead session with the team tools available.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to review this launch plan
say_en.note: runs adversarial critique, then a planner formalizes it

say_en.text: I want cross-critique planning: have 5 members attack my proposal
say_en.note: members attack each other; Lead distills survivors
